why_required.golden_set_circularity: build-golden-set.js generated expected values by calling extractFromSentence() on the same text
why_required.old_audit_non_independence: build-sample-audit.js classified old-vs-new agreement using the new extractor's output as the reference standard
why_required.status_model_bug: reconcile-claims-v2.js assigned scientific_review_status=AMBIGUOUS (an evaluated verdict) to NO_NUMERIC_CONTENT records, which were never evaluated

extractor_bugs_found_and_fixed: unrecognized 'ounces' unit let a dosage number inherit a nearby pH mention's ph_value type
unrecognized time-duration units (hours/minutes/days) had the same false-carry-forward effect
comma-grouped NUM regex alternative allowed zero comma groups, silently truncating comma-less 4+ digit numbers (18000 -> 180, 3200 -> 320)
independent_golden_set.genuine_unfixed_limitation_found: g-syn-034: raw character-distance proximity is not grammar-aware; kept as documented regression anchor, not hidden

independent_old_extraction_audit.methodology: each row classified by reading the source claim sentence directly, never by consulting the new extractor
independent_old_extraction_audit.note: VALUE/UNIT/CONTEXT_MISCLASSIFICATION structurally unobservable -- old system has no value/unit/environment columns, single topic tag per claim
independent_old_extraction_audit.dominant_pattern: pH as false attractor: 14 of 22 parameter misclassifications had pH tagged while the true subject was total_alkalinity/water_temperature/lsi/cyanuric_acid/calcium_hardness

new_extractor_accuracy.dedicated_regression_suite: 24/24 assertions (scripts/phase-7d-2/test-extraction-regression.js, Steps 9-12 named tests A-J + context + impossible-mapping + claim-type)
new_extractor_accuracy.scope_of_100pct_claim: Limited to the 104 golden cases + 24 regression assertions independently evaluated; not claimed as full-population accuracy

residual_limitations: singular 'gallon' not recognized as pool_volume trigger
'N times' multiplier phrasing not specially typed
'and' as clause-delimiter prevents environment='both' via 'X and Y' phrasing
chemical_dosage has no lexical trigger, unreachable as a parameter_id
